scenes.text: Imagine standing in the middle of a brutal, scorching desert with absolutely nothing around you for two hundred and fifty miles, with no water and only endless blowing sand.
Yet right there, completely alone, a single miraculous acacia tree survived the harsh Sahara heat for over one hundred and fifty years by drilling its roots deep into the earth.
It became a sacred, highly protected landmark for weary travelers, until a truck driver with the entire empty desert to navigate somehow managed to crash directly into this lone tree.
It makes you wonder how such unbelievably bad luck is even possible, so let me know in the comments if you would have hit the only tree for hundreds of miles.
